howItWorks.title: From First Greeting to Blessed Nikah
howItWorks.step1Desc: Introduce yourself with key preferences and the character of match you seek for your loved one.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Register conveniently via WhatsApp or at our office. All terms and processes are explained with total clarity beforehand.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Complete the form on our site, tap Copy, paste into WhatsApp with 2-3 recent pictures. Nothing is stored on this site.
howItWorks.step3Cta: Ready for step 3? Fill your profile form
howItWorks.step4Desc: Our team prepares your dignified profile layout. Your family reviews and approves every word before anything is shared.
howItWorks.step5Desc: Curated proposals matched to your criteria are shared by Ref ID only. Respected partner networks widen the reach.
howItWorks.step6Desc: Contact details and family conversations are facilitated solely when both families express genuine mutual agreement.
howItWorks.step7Desc: Respective families arrange an auspicious sitting at a mutual time and location to finalize the blessed rishta.

privacyPromise.title: Your Family's Dignity and Confidentiality
privacyPromise.desc: Absolute discretion is our guiding principle. We honor cultural sensibilities and safeguard your personal details with unwavering care.
privacyPromise.point1: No candidate names, father's names, phone numbers, or addresses are ever broadcasted publicly.
privacyPromise.point2: Every profile is circulated strictly under an anonymous Reference ID (format AMB-001).
privacyPromise.point3: Photographs are exchanged strictly family-to-family with your express prior consent.
privacyPromise.point4: All introductions are conducted through parents, lawful guardians, or elder family representatives.
